uploads/science/Scipad/Year 9 Book 1/Wor.searchText: ECOLOGY Habitats A habitat is a place where a plant or animal lives. Habitats provide a place where organisms can find food, shelter and reproduce. One example of a habitat is a harbour. A harbour provides shelter, food and a place to reproduce for fish, shellfish, stingrays and even whales.
